title: A Different Kind of Origin Story

entities.name: Eleni
entities.description: A young elf girl of the Knotvine tribe from Naya, stranded in Jund, who leads the narrator through the wurm-ridden caves and later thrives among a human warrior-clan.

entities.name: The Narrator
entities.description: A Wizards of the Coast creative designer who, in a dream, is pulled into the world of the Homelost Elf card and is called a wizard by Eleni, though he cannot cast spells.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A proud and ruthless elf nature-mage from Zendikar, revealed as the grown version of the card's elf youth; she seeks to prove elves are the true stewards of the planes.

entities.name: Undead Jundwurm
entities.description: A rotting, lava-draped undead wurm that burrows through Jund's caverns and hunts Eleni and the narrator.

entities.name: Relic of Progenitus
entities.description: An eye-shaped pendant in Eleni's hair, reminiscent of the elvish monument to Progenitus, which destroys the undead wurm when she shouts its command word.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A volcanic, dragon-preyed shard of Alara of savage foliage, lava and raid-clans.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A paradise-jungle shard of Alara and Eleni's home.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose shards Naya and Jund appear in the narrator's work on Alara Reborn.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The world Nissa Revane hails from.

entities.name: Knotvine tribe
entities.description: The elf tribe of Naya to which Eleni belongs.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A being honored by a sacred elvish monument on Naya.

events.summary: The narrator, a creative designer working late, finds the Homelost Elf card too simple and lacking character.
events.quote: Things needed to get Vorthos all up in here, and they needed to do so now.

events.summary: The power goes out and the narrator is suddenly transported into a dim cave, where a young girl tells him to keep quiet.
events.quote: I hit my head on something rough and hard, where only air should have been.

events.summary: The narrator realizes he is in Jund with an elf child as a wurm thunders overhead.
events.quote: The cavern shook in time with a thunderous impact above.

events.summary: The girl introduces herself as Eleni of the Knotvine tribe and asks the narrator, whom she takes for a wizard, to save them; his powers do not work without mana.
Eleni scrambles down a tunnel to find mana, and the narrator follows.
The ceiling collapses as the undead wurm plunges through, separating the narrator and Eleni.
The narrator leaps the chasm toward the lava pool Eleni hopes will provide mana, and she helps pull him up.
The wurm bursts up through the lava, draped in it, and charges them; the narrator falls onto a ledge and is trapped.
Eleni refuses to abandon the trapped narrator.
The narrator tells Eleni to use the relic of Progenitus and she shouts a command word, disintegrating the wurm.
events.quote: The wurm disintegrated in a mass of smoking ash, billowing apart as the lava consumed it.

events.summary: Eleni rescues the narrator, finds food and shelter, and negotiates with a human warrior-clan, becoming one of them.
The narrator wakes in his bedroom, finds the card art changed to a capable warrior, and renames it.
events.quote: I changed its name, and signed off.

events.summary: The narrator reveals the card is Nissa Revane, a proud and ruthless nature-mage from Zendikar.
events.quote: This is Nissa Revane, a proud and ruthless nature-mage.

relations.note: Eleni refuses to abandon him and rescues him.
The wurm hunts Eleni and the narrator.
relations.quote: Its lava-infused bulk looked like a fiery halo of death around Eleni.
She hails from a world known as Zendikar
